name: industry-watchlist-research
description: Build and audit evidence-backed cross-border industry watchlists, with peer groups, current earnings drivers, event maps, and broker format gates.

interface.longDescription: Use connected research sources and independent verification to discover missing companies, construct global peers and HOME/EVENT watchlists, then validate and export broker-ready files only when supported.
defaultPrompt: Google Drive 자료와 최신 해외 IR로 전기전자 관심종목 HOME/EVENT를 검산하고 업데이트해줘.
BTM 산업에서 Generac처럼 누락된 글로벌 기업을 찾아 피어를 다시 구성해줘.
기존 MASTER를 확인하고 삼성증권·한국투자증권 관심종목용으로 검증해줘.
